BackstoryDef.title: cistern-hatched
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] could swim before [PAWN_pronoun] could walk, raised in the flooded vaults where the Compact keeps its wealth in the only currency that matters. [PAWN_pronoun] learned early that every drop is counted, every pump has a keeper, and the desert above is a place other people are unlucky enough to live.

BackstoryDef.title: toll-wharf child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up on the wharfs where the desert comes to buy, watching every bucket get metered and every argument end the same way. Empire quartermasters, Jawa traders and Hutt collectors all waited in the same line, and the wardens made sure nobody's blaster changed the price.

BackstoryDef.title: water warden
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] stood guard over the reservoirs — the armed half of a neutrality everyone honors because everyone must drink. [PAWN_pronoun] has faced down raid parties without firing a shot and knows the Compact's oldest truth: you do not need to chase anyone who will be back at the wharf, thirsty, within a tenday.

BackstoryDef.title: purification engineer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kept the great filters breathing — the machinery that turns brine, rot and worse into the Compact's monopoly. [PAWN_pronoun] thinks in flow rates and contamination margins, and judges any settlement first by its plumbing and second by nothing else.

BackstoryDef.title: compact factor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] sold water to the Empire in the morning and to the people the Empire was hunting that afternoon, and slept soundly. A factor of the Compact serves the Balance: every side pays, no side is favored, and the ledger does not care who wins. It is not cynicism, [PAWN_pronoun] will tell you — it is the only peace this planet has ever managed.
